books.title: The Pilgrim's Progress
books.author: John Bunyan
books.blurb: The SchriftOhr Edition: Bunyan's complete text — both parts, unmodernised — with the journey's stages set as real chapters, a Scripture-only footnote apparatus, and Bunyan's own writings gathered as endnotes. Set for reading, for listening, and for discussion in company.
books.source: The Works of John Bunyan, ed. George Offor, 1855, via Project Gutenberg and Standard Ebooks

books.author: Robert Pollok
books.blurb: Pollok's three classic tales of Scotland's covenanting days — Helen of the Glen, Ralph Gemmell, and The Persecuted Family — from the illustrated 1895 Edinburgh edition, with a sketch of Pollok's life.
